productName: French Country 7 Drawer Dresser with Top Mirror
description:
The French Country 7 Drawer Dresser with Top Mirror gives you seven drawers and a mirror in one piece.

Seven dovetailed drawers with full-extension glides provide storage for clothing, blankets, and nursery supplies. The dresser measures 60 inches wide, 33½ inches high, and 21½ inches deep, and it is crafted from solid wood with the signature French Country detailing.

The warm finishes and rustic charm coordinate with the full French Country collection for a beautifully cohesive nursery.

If you would like help choosing a finish, confirming timing, or picturing how this piece fits your nursery plans, use Get Personal Assistance. We reply the same or next business day so you can decide with full information, at your own pace.
